description: The line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 (minFDE20) metric, measured in meters (m), varies with the ratio of in-context pool size across five different methods: TrajICL (blue circles with solid line), Head Tuning (orange circles with solid line), FT (green circles with solid line), LoRA 16 (red circles with solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple circles with solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Ratio,” spans from 0.2 to 1.0 in linear scale, representing the proportion of the in-context pool used. The y-axis, labeled “minFDE20 (m),” ranges from 18 to 23 meters, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines every 1 meter. TrajICL shows a consistent downward trend, starting at approximately 20.4 m at ratio 0.2 and decreasing to about 18.0 m at ratio 1.0. Head Tuning remains relatively stable, hovering between 22.8 m and 23.0 m across all ratios. FT begins at ~22.2 m, dips to ~21.7 m at ratio 0.2, rises slightly, then drops to ~20.7 m at ratio 0.6 before stabilizing near 21.0 m. LoRA 16 starts near 22.9 m, declines gradually to ~22.0 m at ratio 0.8, then rises slightly to ~22.2 m at ratio 1.0. LoRA 64 begins at ~22.9 m, decreases steadily to ~22.1 m at ratio 0.8, then rises slightly to ~22.2 m at ratio 1.0. All lines are connected by solid lines with circular markers at each data point.
